reports.title: Demographic Reports | Doctor Demographics
reports.description: Doctor Demographics provides different reports to help doctors make crucial decisions at every stage of their research. Whether you have a practice location picked out or are early in the process, we have a custom hand-written report to fit your needs.

best-sites-report.title: Best Sites Report
best-sites-report.description: This is really a combination between a Report and a Consultation. It will take the geographic area YOU define (up to 5 Counties in the same State) and the priorities that YOU state.

site-viability-report.title: Site Viability Report
site-viability-report.description: Most often this Report is used to determine practice viability before you risk your money or a paper is signed. This is often used as part of an SBA package. The Report will break down 14 CONTIGUOUS Zip Codes as well as 5-, 10-, and 15-minute drive-time radii.

marketing-report.title: Marketing Report | Doctor Demographics
marketing-report.description: This is a research-based tool to help practices promote their practices cost-efficiently. It is NOT a pre-fabricated package of standard-issue tools. It is an in-depth analysis of the practice’s current or proposed brand, current or proposed marketing tools, competition, and clinical offerings.

telephone-consultation.title: Telephone Consultation | Doctor Demographics
telephone-consultation.description: Get Immediate help with your practice placement, marketing, and other challenging situation with a live telephone consultation.

comp-report.title: Competition Report
comp-report.description: Unlock the potential of your practice with our tailored Competition Report, designed exclusively for professional practices (Dental, Medical, Veterinary, Optometry, etc)  seeking to thrive in their local market. This comprehensive analysis delivers actionable insights to help you attract more patients and stand out from the competition.

quick-view-report.title: Quick View Report | Doctor Demographics
quick-view-report.description: The Quick View Report is exactly that - a brief analysis of an area or site. The report is about 16 pages in length and is primarily built for consultants, realtors, and others who are helping practice owners gain a better view of an area demographically.

on-site-report.title: On-Site Demographic Marketing Report
on-site-report.description: The On-Site Demographic Marketing Report and Consultation is for when the risks are high and the potential rewards are great, you don’t want to play around with partial answers. You need the facts that only an on-site consultation and report will offer.

state-briefings.title: State Briefings | Doctor Demographics
state-briefings.description: The State Briefing gives doctor's a little guidance on which States hold most promise and what should doctors know about these states to make a decisions.

blog__b__big-city-exodus.title: Big City Exodus
blog__b__big-city-exodus.description: In this episode, we reveal the top five mid- and large-sized U.S. markets with the brightest futures for opening a practice in 2026. From booming population growth and strong economic outlooks to business-friendly local governments, these spots—Orlando, Austin, Nashville, Charlotte, and Boise—offer low taxes, incentives, and high demand for healthcare services.

blog__b__demographic-marketing.title: Demographic Marketing
blog__b__demographic-marketing.description: How to use demographic data from doctor demographics to create the perfect marketing strategy for your practice.

blog__b__kiss-of-death-locations-for-202.title: Kiss of Death Locations for 2026
blog__b__kiss-of-death-locations-for-202.description: In this eye-opening episode, we reveal the "Kiss of Death Locations for 2026" – 8 markets (small, midsize, and large) that could spell disaster for new practice. From population loss and economic decline to hostile regulations and high costs, we'll break down why these spots are toxic for growth and what red flags to watch for.

blog__b__launch-smart-5-demographic-fact.title: Launch Smart: 5 Demographic Factors for Your New Practice
blog__b__launch-smart-5-demographic-fact.description: Join Mike Green from Doctor Demographics on The Perfect Place to Put a Practice as we uncover the five demographic factors you need to know before opening your first practice. From population growth to competition, we’ll break down how to choose a location that maximizes your success. Packed with data-driven insights and actionable tips, this 17-minute episode is a must-listen for new practice owners.

blog__b__places-with-promise-2026.title: Places with Promise 2026

From booming population growth and strong economic outlooks to business-friendly local governments, these spots—Orlando, Austin, Nashville, Charlotte, and Boise—offer low taxes, incentives, and high demand for healthcare services.

blog__b__relocate-or-revamp.title: Relocate or Revamp
blog__b__relocate-or-revamp.description: In this episode, we tackle a common dilemma for dentists, veterinarians, optometrists, and other practice owners: Should you relocate your struggling practice or revamp your marketing instead? Discover why ineffective marketing is often the real culprit behind slow growth, not your location.
